derived_current_contracts: FUNCTIONAL_ASYMMETRY_NOT_METAPHYSICAL_PROOF: access-bound information asymmetry is an engineered agent-relative property, not evidence of principled first-person inaccessibility.
CORRELATION_NOT_CAUSATION: Bayesian/temporal links remain associations until controlled intervention or equivalent causal identification evidence exists.
COUNTERFACTUAL_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED: claims of structural simulation equivalence require explicit intervention tests that can falsify equivalence.

SENSOR_TRUTH_VS_EXPERIENCE_PROJECTION: hardware metrics may ground a body/self model, but numeric sensor facts, qualitative projections and subjective-language claims remain distinct provenance layers.
PROMPT_GROUNDING_SCOPE: autonomous prompts may reference only resolvable sensed/retrieved world state; imagined human-world experiences must not be injected as facts.
PORTABLE_USER_IDENTITY: product prompts use configured user identity/role state, not hardcoded owner names.
THEORY_DOCS_ARE_HYPOTHESIS_PROVENANCE: papers/README/manuals preserve intellectual history but never substitute for executable evidence.
RUNTIME_COUPLING_NEEDS_PROPAGATION_ORACLES: topology documentation and component presence do not prove E-PQ/workspace/AURA/router effects propagate end-to-end.
